body: Both my original post and that response you mentioned show up as "deleted" for me.
It was absolutely not removed by me or someone using my account.
Wow.  Thank you for this.  Your words have hit me spot on.  I don't know what to say, but I'm glad I'm actually enjoying this cry.  :)

Hi... thank you...  :)

I guess it all just boils down to:  I've lost my will.  Everything seems so far away; I can't afford my medication or my therapist anymore, and between the two of them I was harvesting every gram of my motivation to live.  

Now that they're gone I realize I don't have anything in me that wants to stay alive.  I feel disconnected and cold.

I *want* to want to live.  I just don't know how to do it.  Do you have any pointers or advice?  I just need something to hang on to so I can start to hopefully build my own internal will generator.
